title: TermAdvice
description: The model's advice on each search term the approval card warns about (D232). The card warns when one term multiplies the matches of the search; the model says, for each warned term, whether to remove it or keep it, and gives one plain sentence for a reader who is not an expert. Asked once per approval that has a warning, with no repair. The advice is shown as information beside the warning and changes nothing: under the default warn mode every term is kept and the search runs as proposed; only a person who is asked (ask mode) can remove a term.

advice.description: Exactly one entry per warned term: every warned term, none twice, none that was not warned. Otherwise the whole output is not used.

phrase.description: One of the warned terms, copied exactly.

recommendation.description: remove: the term pulls in papers outside the question. keep: the term is part of what the question asks, so taking it out would lose relevant papers.

reason.description: One plain sentence in English for a reader who is not an expert.
